general_rules.rule: Always consult a qualified Vedic astrologer before wearing any gemstone.
Gemstones should be natural, untreated, and free from cracks or inclusions.
Wear gemstones on the prescribed day, time, and metal for best results.
Purify the gemstone with Ganga Jal, raw milk, honey, and water before wearing.
Chant the associated mantra 108 times before wearing the gemstone.
Gemstones should touch the skin directly.
Do not wear gemstones of malefic planets for your Lagna or Rashi.
Test gemstones like Neelam (Blue Sapphire) for 3-7 days before permanent wearing.
Gemstones should be re-energized periodically (every 6-12 months).
Do not share your gemstone with anyone else.
Remove gemstone before bathing, sleeping (optional), or during inauspicious activities.
Multiple gemstones can be worn if planets are friendly to each other.
If gemstone cracks, breaks, or falls out, replace it immediately.
